title: Errors in code
description: Tap the faulty lines and fix them in the new code panel.
instructions: Find the line with the error, then choose the fix.
The code panel scrolls sideways if a line is long.

questions.question: This algorithm should display the factorial of n. One line has an error.
questions.code:
Read(n)
Let fact ← 0
For i From 1 To n Do
    fact ← fact * i
EndDo
Display(fact)
questions.explanation: fact starts at 0, so every product stays 0. It must start at 1, the neutral value for a product.

questions.question: This algorithm should add the 5 elements of E. Two lines have an error.
questions.code:
Declare sum As Integer
Let sum ← 1
For i From 1 To 5 Do
    Read(E[i])
    sum ← sum * E[i]
EndDo
Display(sum)
questions.explanation: Line 2: a sum must start at 0, not 1. Line 5: we must add (+), not multiply (*).

questions.question: This loop should display the numbers 1 to 10. Find the faulty line and choose its fix.
questions.code:
Let i ← 1
While i < 10 Do
    Display(i)
    i ← i + 1
EndDo
questions.explanation: With i < 10 the loop stops before 10 is displayed. The final value is included, so the test is i <= 10.

questions.question: This algorithm should count how many payments were made. Find the faulty line and type its fix.
questions.code:
Let Count ← 0
For i From 1 To 5 Do
    Read(Pay)
    Count ← Count + Pay
EndDo
Display(Count)
questions.explanation: A counter goes up by 1 each time. Adding Pay turns it into a total.

questions.question:
What does this algorithm display?
```
Let x ← 17
Let y ← x MOD 5
Let z ← x DIV 5
Display(y + z)
```
questions.explanation: 17 MOD 5 = 2 and 17 DIV 5 = 3, so y + z = 5.
